title: scenarioHealth
responsibility: Builds a report-only summary of documented viewport ids, size conflicts, state coverage, and active or retired units without scenario coverage.

inputs.name: scenarioHealth.input
inputs.description: Scenario manifests and unit identity, kind, and lifecycle facts to summarize.

outputs.name: documentedViewports
outputs.description: Viewport ids promised by documentation: desktop, tablet, and mobile.

outputs.name: scenarioHealth
outputs.description: Counts scenarios, viewport ids and conflicting sizes, state coverage classifications, and active or retired units absent from all scenarios.

outputs.name: renderScenarioHealth
outputs.description: Human-readable report lines; unit ids are omitted in favor of the command’s JSON output.
